texts.zh:
在我们掌握超光速航行技术前，[Root.Capital.GetName]派出的一些亚光速探测器以近相对论速度前往临近的星系进行探索。开发探测器的科学家天真地在存储内核中输入了我们文明的敏感信息作为向外星文明的问候。

现在，人们终于意识到这些信息可能被用来对付我们。我们必须趁早追回那些探测器，以免落入那些对我们虎视眈眈的外星生物之手。
texts.en:
Before we developed faster-than-light travel, several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] at near-relativistic speeds towards nearby systems. The scientists who developed the probes naively included sensitive information about our culture in their memory cores as a form of greeting to alien civilizations.

It has now been realized that this data could potentially be used against us. We need to track down these probes before they are found by someone - or something - unsympathetic to our species!

label.en: They can't have gotten far.

tooltips.zh: 开始亚光速探测器事件链
tooltips.en: Begins the Sublight Exploration Probes Event Chain

label.zh: 舰队进入四个标记星系之一：发现探测器（直接回收）
label.en: A fleet enters one of the four marked systems: probe found (direct recovery)

label.zh: 舰队进入标记星系：亚空间异常现象

label.zh: 舰队进入标记星系：改造探测器

notes.zh: 触发：游戏开始后由开局事件闸门 country.900 抽取（events/game_start.txt:15 在460±60天后触发；events/country_events_2.txt:17-66 为按权重的随机列表，四条开局故事互斥，另有69%什么都不发生）。另有 country.258 在带故事旗标或已有通讯对象时放行，否则180天后重试（country_events_1.txt:13-37）；仅限非AI玩家（L49-52）。
notes.en: Trigger: After game start the starting-event gate country.900 draws it (events/game_start.txt:15 fires it after 460±60 days; events/country_events_2.txt:17-66 is a weighted random list: the four opening stories are mutually exclusive and 69% of the weight is "nothing happens"). country.258 lets it through only if a story flag is set or a communication exists, otherwise it retries after 180 days (country_events_1.txt:13-37); human players only (L49-52).

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.GetStarName]星系发现了我们失去联系的一个亚光速探测器。我们需要尽快展开回收工作。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has detected one of our missing sublight probes in the [Root.GetStarName] system. We should begin recovery efforts as soon as possible.

label.en: Indeed.

texts.zh: 在[space_probe.GetStarName]星系中，我们发现了我们老旧的亚光速探测器。一定要尽快回收。
texts.en: We have sighted one of our old sublight space probes in the [space_probe.GetStarName] system. It must be recovered as soon as possible.

texts.zh: 我们在[space_probe.GetStarName]星系成功回收了该亚光速探测器。经过数年的遥感测控，它所收集到的数据完整描述了该星系内所有星球的勘测结果。
texts.en: We have recovered the sublight probe in the [space_probe.GetStarName] system. The sensor telemetry it has collected over the years has provided us with a complete survey of all planetary bodies within the system.

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]接收到了废弃信标发出的信号，该信标原属于[Root.GetStarName]星系失联的亚光速探测器之一。我们发现一条离子轨迹从信标延伸至另一个恒星，这表明该探测器被拖向该恒星，具体原因不明。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] has picked up a signal from a discarded signal buoy belonging to one of our missing sublight probes in the [Root.GetStarName] system. There is an ion trail leading away from the buoy on a trajectory towards another star, suggesting that someone has towed the probe there for unknown reasons.

label.zh: 我们去看看这条轨迹一直通到哪里。
label.en: Let us see where this trail leads.

label.zh: 舰队抵达离子轨迹尽头的星系
label.en: A fleet reaches the system at the end of the ion trail

texts.zh:
我们找到失联的探测器了！我们在[From.GetName]星系探测到了一支临时拼凑的小型舰队，其中一艘飞船用短距离牵引光束锁住了探测器。

他们正在呼唤我们。
texts.en:
We have found our missing probe! A small fleet of jury-rigged ships has been detected in the [From.GetName] system, and one of them has the probe locked in a short-range tractor beam.

They are hailing us.

label.en: On screen.

texts.zh:
外星人，你们想干什么？这个探测器是我们的。打捞。我们先找到的！赶快离开。是的。你们干扰到我们微操了。一定要聚精会神。

或者……如果你们想要探测器，我们可以卖给你们。只要100能量币，探测器就是你们的了。很划算。巨实惠。探测器是你们的了，我们也省事。双赢。尤其是我们。
texts.en:
What you want, alien? This probe ours. Salvage. We find first! You leave now. Yes. Interrupting delicate operation, your ships are. Must concentrate.

Or... if you want probe, we can sell. 100 credits and probe yours. Good deal. Very good. You get probe, less work for us, everybody wins. Especially us.

label.zh: 归还我们的东西，不然就受死吧！
label.en: Surrender our property or be destroyed!

responses.zh:
吼吼！伙计们，快听听丑陋的外星人在说什么！巴格瓦伊，快放下手中的事，到控制台来！听听这些笨蛋的话！吼吼！

这个探测器现在是我们的。不错的小玩意。你们的船也等着成为我们回收的碎片吧。嘻嘻哈哈哈哈！
responses.en:
Hoho! Listen to ugly alien, boys! Buggwai, drop what you doing and come over to console! Listen to fool! Hoho!

This probe OUR property now. Fair salvage. As will debris from your ships be. HIIYAAAEEE!

label.zh: 击毁打捞舰队，夺回探测器
label.en: Destroy the salvage fleet and take the probe
The salvage fleet is destroyed by another empire

label.zh: 你们还挺会讨价还价的，不过，好吧。
label.en: You drive a hard bargain, but very well.

responses.zh:
很好，很好！探测器就交给你们了，要好好爱护啊。可能有点小磕碰，打捞的时候不小心碰了一下。米格瓦伊不小心趴到了控制台上。真是笨蛋！

但是探测器的功能还是很良好的！恕不退款！我们这就启程了。
responses.en:
Very good, very good! We release probe into your care. May be a bit banged up. There was accidental collision during salvage operation. Miggwai fell on controls. Clumsy oaf!

But probe still in good condition! No refunds! We depart now.

texts.zh: 我们从外星飞船的残骸中回收了亚光速探测器。虽然表面有些凹陷，而且被打捞者涂鸦了外星的文字以标示贵重部件，但我们还是从储存器中下载到了[salvager_system.GetName]全星系的详细勘查数据。
texts.en: We have recovered our sublight probe from the wreckage of the alien salvage ship. It is a bit dented, and parts of it are covered in some kind of alien graffiti put there by the salvagers to mark valuable components. Despite this we have managed to download detailed sensor readings of the entire [salvager_system.GetName] system from the probe's memory banks.

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh: [salvager_system.GetName]星系中的密探无人机确认打捞舰队已经被摧毁。该舰队先前曾无效宣称占有我们失踪的太空探测器。不过探测器在战斗期间随着打捞飞船一同被摧毁了，这也算是不幸中的万幸。因此，不必再担心上面携带的敏感数据会落入心怀不轨之人的手中了。
texts.en: Spy drones in the [salvager_system.GetName] system have confirmed that someone else destroyed the salvage fleet which had unlawfully laid claim to our missing space probe. Fortunately, it looks like the probe itself was destroyed along with the salvagers during the battle, so there is no risk of its sensitive data falling into the wrong hands.

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh:
打捞者信守承诺将探测器转交给了我们。转让工作一完成，他们的舰队就朝着未知的方向离开了星系。

虽然探测器的状况不是很好，但我们还是从储存器中下载到了[salvager_system.GetName]全星系的详细勘查数据。
texts.en:
The salvagers kept their word and transferred the probe over to our control. As soon as the transfer was complete, their fleet departed the system on an unknown heading.

Although the probe is in rough condition, we managed to download detailed sensor readings of the entire [salvager_system.GetName] system from its memory banks.

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.GetStarName]星系中探测到了规模巨大的亚空间异常。异常的中心似乎是我们丢失的亚光速传感器之一！
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] has detected a massive subspace anomaly in the [Root.GetStarName] system. It appears to be centered on one of our missing sublight probes!

label.en: We must proceed with caution.
Destroy the subspace anomaly fleet
The anomaly fleet is destroyed by another empire

texts.zh: 我们已经处理掉了失联探测器吸引来的亚空间生物。这种生物为什么会被陈旧的无人飞行器吸引还不得而知，但所幸探测器总体并无严重受损。探测器已经被我们回收，而且我们已经从储存器中下载到了[anomaly_system.GetName]全星系的详细勘查数据。此外，亚空间异常留下的残余能源为我们的科学家提供了宝贵的物理数据。
texts.en:
We have dealt with the hostile subspace entity that our missing probe had attracted. Why such a creature would be drawn to an archaic unmanned spacecraft is a mystery, but the probe appears to be largely undamaged.

It has been recovered by our forces, and we have extracted detailed survey readings on the entire [anomaly_system.GetName] from its memory banks. In addition, the residual energy left behind by the subspace anomaly has generated a large amount of valuable physics data for our scientists.

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh:
我们已经成功回收全部的失联亚光速探测器！其中涉及我们文明的详细数据现在已经安全，不会再被外星人窥视。

通过这些探测器的遥测协作，我们得以完全测绘周边数个星系。
texts.en:
We have successfully collected all of our missing sublight probes! The detailed information they held on our culture is now safe from prying alien photoreceptors.

With their combined sensor telemetry, we have been able to fully survey a number of additional neighboring systems.

label.en: Excellent.

notes.zh: 四个探测器全部回收后（计数达到上限）触发；奖励物理研究与能量，并勘测首都附近若干星系（country_events_1.txt:1205-1328）。
notes.en: Fires after all four probes are recovered (counter at its maximum); rewards physics research and energy and surveys several systems near the capital (country_events_1.txt:1205-1328).

title.zh: 亚空间异常现象已消除

texts.zh: 我们位于[anomaly_system.GetName]星系的失联太空探测器周围环绕着亚空间异常。现在据深空追踪传感器确认，异常已经被不明力量消除。探测器也已在战斗中被毁。所以我们已经不必再担心敏感情报泄露。
texts.en: Deep space tracking sensors confirm that someone else destroyed the subspace anomaly that was guarding our missing space probe in the [anomaly_system.GetName] system. The probe itself was also destroyed during the battle, so we no longer need to worry about the sensitive data it contained.

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh: 一个扫过[Root.GetName]的传感器在[Root.GetStarName]星系发现了我们的一个亚光速探测器，可是似乎……有些不太一样了。探测器外壳上加装了外星技术的改造部件，且能源特征远超正常水平。我们接收到了它发送过来的信号！
texts.en:
A sensor sweep from the [Root.GetName] has revealed one of our sublight probes in the [Root.GetStarName] system, but it seems to have been... altered somehow. Modifications of an alien origin have been attached to its hull, and the probe's energy signature is far greater than it should be.

We are receiving a transmission from it!

label.en: On screen.

texts.zh: 嘶嘶吱吱……你们是……我的造物主吗？

label.en: Yes. We made you.

responses.zh: 咳呀呀……那么……你们……就……去死吧……

label.en: Destroy the modified probe

label.zh: 改造探测器被他国击毁
label.en: The modified probe is destroyed by another empire
No. What are you?

texts.zh: 加装外星改造部件的失联探测器已经被毁得支离破碎，但我们仍然从残骸中收集到了一些宝贵的工程数据。探测器的数据库也得以收回，我们从中提取出了[modified_probe_system.GetName]星系的全部测绘数据。
texts.en: Little remains of the strange alien modifications that our missing sublight probe had been subjected to, but we did manage to collect some valuable engineering data from the wreckage. Its memory bank was also salvaged, and from it we have extracted survey data of the entire [modified_probe_system.GetName] system.

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh: 远程扫描确认位于[modified_probe_system.GetName]星系的改造探测器已经被不明力量摧毁。所幸战斗后数据库也已被毁，因此不必再担心里面所包含的敏感数据落入外星势力之手。
texts.en: Long-range scans have confirmed that someone else destroyed our modified probe in the [modified_probe_system.GetName] system. Fortunately, nothing remained of its memory banks after the battle so there is no chance of foreign powers having acquired the sensitive data that was contained therein.

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh: 早在掌握超光速旅行之前，我们从[Root.Capital.GetName]向邻近的恒星系发射了数个亚光速探测器。我们必须在它们落入敌人的手中之前先将他们回收。
texts.en: Several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] to neighboring systems before we had mastered FTL travel. They must be recovered before they fall into hostile hands.

summary.text:
# 亚光速探测器 / Sublight Exploration Probes

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/country_events_1.txt:11-1328; events/game_start.txt:15; events/country_events_2.txt:10-68; common/event_chains/00_event_chains.txt:124-133; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:981-986,1573,1615-1616,2042-2045 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

开局事件闸门 country.900 在游戏开始约460天后抽取一条开局故事（亚光速探测器、激进信徒、浪迹星涯、大灭绝，互斥）。探测器故事权重10（有“年轻”起源时为0）。通过 country.258 后弹出 country.1，开启“亚光速探测器”事件链，并在首都2到6跳内随机选四个无主星系作为探测点。

The starting-event gate country.900 draws one opening story about 460 days after game start (Sublight Probes, Radical Cult, Wanderlust, Mass Extinction; mutually exclusive). Probes weigh 10 (0 with a "young" origin). Once country.258 lets it through, country.1 opens the "Sublight Exploration Probes" chain and marks four unowned systems 2-6 jumps from the capital.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

玩家用舰队进入四个标记星系中的任何一个（任意顺序）。隐藏事件 country.2 随机决定遭遇：(1) 发现探测器 country.3，启动“回收探测器”特殊项目，完成后 country.4；(2) 离子轨迹 country.5，追到终点遇到打捞舰 country.6/7，可付100能量买回（country.8）或开战（country.9，若他国击毁则 country.17）；(3) 亚空间异常 country.10，击毁异常舰队得 country.11（他国击毁为 country.19）；(4) 改造探测器 country.12/13，击毁得 country.14（他国击毁为 country.21）。每回收一个探测器计数加一，四个都回收后 country.15 结束事件链并给奖励。

Fleets entering any of the four marked systems (any order) trigger the hidden event country.2, which draws an encounter at random: (1) a probe is found, country.3, starting the "Recover the probe" special project and later country.4; (2) an ion trail, country.5, leading to salvagers (country.6/7) who can be bought off for 100 energy (country.8) or fought (country.9, or country.17 if someone else kills them); (3) a subspace anomaly, country.10, destroyed for country.11 (country.19 if someone else does it); (4) a modified probe, country.12/13, destroyed for country.14 (country.21 if someone else does it). Each recovered probe adds to the counter; when all four are back country.15 ends the chain with a reward.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

同一星系一次只抽一种遭遇；离子轨迹、亚空间异常、改造探测器各自置旗后不会再抽到，因此四个探测点最多各出现一次这三类，其余为直接发现。三类敌对遭遇都有“自己击毁/他国击毁”两种结局，最终都汇入 country.15。

One encounter is drawn per system; ion trail, anomaly and modified probe each set a flag and are not drawn again, so each of those three appears at most once. The three hostile encounters each end either by our own victory or by another empire killing the foe, and all join country.15.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

仅限人类玩家；country.258 要求已有故事旗标或通讯对象。能否买回探测器取决于能量储备（country.7.b 需要100能量）。

Human players only; country.258 requires a story flag or an existing contact. Buying the probe back needs 100 energy (country.7.b).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 对照 country_events_1.txt 与 country_events_2.txt、事件链定义与 on_action 钩子核对了全部事件；把原先散落的 country.2/6/9/11/14/16/18/20 各个“故事”并入此故事，并删去了把开局闸门当成大杂烩的旧结构；其他开局故事（激进信徒、浪迹星涯、大灭绝）各自成故事。
  Checked every event against country_events_1.txt, country_events_2.txt, the chain definition and the on_action hooks; the previously scattered country.2/6/9/11/14/16/18/20 pseudo-stories are merged here and the old catch-all opening-gate structure is removed; the other opening stories (Radical Cult, Wanderlust, Mass Extinction) are separate stories.
- （以上为审阅者撰写的说明，不是游戏原文；原文见阅读页。）
